dedupe_keys.name: data and code for source node management in complex water network based on cascading failure and bidirectional risk transmission the case of henan province

description: The Henan water-network research team publishes data and Python code for testing cascading failures and bidirectional risk transmission. Zenodo provides separate S1 and S2 archives under CC BY 4.0. S1 contains network-construction, reservoir-node, junction and water-use inputs, plus six-zone sensitivity classes. S2 contains topological construction, forward and reverse cascading-failure simulations and K-means clustering. This model can explore how source-node choices affect propagation in a complex regional water network. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this code-and-data release. Coverage is the Henan case and its chosen topology, not a verified hydraulic digital twin of every reservoir or pipe. A limitation is that topology-based risk transmission can differ from physical flows, operating rules and repair behaviour. The page calls the data minimal, so calibration details may be absent. Neither archive was downloaded, and no cascade or cluster result was reproduced.
